name: Crepes (Sweet/Savoury)
ingredients: Finely chopped green chilies and onions (for savoury version)
instructions: 1. Whisk the flour, eggs, milk, and a pinch of salt together in a bowl until the batter is thin and free of lumps.
2. Divide the batter; add sugar and cardamom to one portion for sweet crepes, and add chopped onions, green chilies, and salt to the other for savoury crepes.
3. Heat a non-stick flat skillet or tava and grease it lightly with butter or ghee.
4. Pour a ladle of batter onto the center and swirl the pan to spread it into a thin, even circle.
5. Cook on medium heat until the edges lift and the underside turns golden brown.
6. Flip carefully and cook for another 30 seconds.
7. Serve warm, either plain or rolled with a filling of choice.
description: Influenced by French colonial history, crepes have become a staple in the unique Creole cuisine of Puducherry. They represent a cultural fusion where traditional French techniques meet local Indian flavors, often enjoyed as a light breakfast or a tea-time snack.
